newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-RANGERS INTERESTED IN BAERON, NEWSPAPERS SAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RANGERS INTERESTED IN BAERON, NEWSPAPERS SAY.

text.p: Scottish champions Glasgow Rangers are interested in signing Hamburg striker Karsten Baeron, German newspapers reported on Thursday.

Baeron, 23, has been attracting a great deal of interest from foreign clubs as his contract with the German first division club runs out at the end of the season. He has also been linked with Italian club Internazionale Milan.
The Scottish champions have not made an official offer to Hamburg.
Baeron said: "I am not making any comments about my future until the Bundesliga winter break (starting in December)."
